children: American Healthcare REIT completed acquisition of six Kensington senior housing communities for ~$572 million, advancing a strategic long-term partnership.
Acquired six of eight Class A communities for approximately $572 million (464 units) as part of an $873M portfolio.
Remaining two communities under definitive agreements expected to close in Q4 2026 pending closing conditions.
About 93% of the portfolio's units are assisted living and memory care, aligning with higher-acuity strategy.
AHR’s year-to-date investments now exceed $2 billion; awarded pipeline stands at over $675 million.
Transaction establishes long-term strategic relationship with Kensington, which will continue operating the communities.
